dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: In a corner of the notebooks and textbooks inside the classroom, there was Matthew.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Why can my classmates easily solve these real-life math problems? I look at these numbers and word problems, and I struggle so much... I just do not understand any of it!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: In the afternoon, Matthew was called by one of his teachers, Ma'am Cruz.

dialogues.name: ma'am cruz
dialogues.log: Matthew, I called you here to discuss your grades. You are about to fail your Math subject. To pass, you MUST pass the Math Test on our upcoming examination.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: The upcoming examination... I don't know what to do, Ma'am Cruz. I want to learn, but numbers confuse me!

dialogues.name: ma'am cruz
dialogues.log: You have curiosity and heart, Matthew. Practice diligently on the way home, learn the basic clues of every problem, and believe in yourself.

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: One day on the way home in an empty alley, Matthew feels strange...

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Wait... what is that glowing light in the alley wall? It feels like the air is humming with magical energy!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: He saw a shimmering portal floating in the air. He was scared and curious, so he stepped closer to the portal and touched it.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Whoaaa! The portal is pulling me in!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: On the other side of the portal is another world! Matthew arrived in a magical forest.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Where am I?! Glowing numbers floating in the trees? Geometric flowers? I feel completely overwhelmed by the things I am seeing!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Oh no! The portal is closed! How will I ever get back home to prepare for my upcoming exam?!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: While wandering in the forest, Matthew met Arith, a kind student of AcadeMath.

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: Hello there, traveler! You look lost. My name is Arith, a student at AcadeMath.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Hi Arith! I am Matthew. I came through a portal from Earth. I need to get back home to prepare for my school exam, but the portal closed!

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: A portal huh, do not worry, Matthew! The only person that can help you open the portal is the Great Math Wizard at the castle. Come, I will guide and accompany you to see him!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Arith guided and accompanied Matthew to Magi-Mathica's Castle. When they arrived, they talked to the Great Math Wizard.

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: Welcome, young Matthew from Earth! I sense your troubled heart about the mathematics of your world.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Great Wizard, please help me! I want to go home and prepare for my upcoming exam, but the portal is locked tight.

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: The portal is bound by the laws of mathematical truth. You need to collect a Learning Experience (EXP) here at Magi-Mathica and pass my Test so that I can give you the Key to open the Portal!

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: I will guide Matthew on how to gain the Learning Experience and how he will pass the Wizard's Quiz! We will enroll him at AcadeMath!

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: Very well! Begin with the foundational magic of numbers. Return when you have mastered the four sacred operations and earned the medals of AcadeMath!

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: Thank you, Great Wizard! Come on, Matthew. Let us head back to my house. I have the perfect magical book to start your training!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: With their quest officially set, Arith guided Matthew out of the castle and straight to his study room to retrieve the Magical Book.

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Arith and Matthew reached their distination, Arith handled Matthew a magical book containing basic understanding for numbers, like counting.

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: Here is your first magical primer, Matthew! To apply at AcadeMath, the first requirement is to identify numbers and count objects with accuracy. Let us practice right here!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Let me open the book! I am ready to learn number identification and counting!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew learned how to identify numbers and count objects. Matthew and Arith then went to the Academy to process Matthew's application.

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: This is the office of our revered Principal, Mr. Archimedes. He will interview you and test your basic number knowledge!

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Greetings, Matthew! To admit you into AcadeMath, I must interview you with questions about: How many are these objects? And arrange these numbers in order!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I am ready, Mr. Archimedes! Let's begin the entrance test!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Routine of Matthew: Before going to Arith's house and heading to school, Matthew must buy food for energy!

dialogues.name: baker pip
dialogues.log: Good morning, young scholar! Fresh star-fruit buns and mana pies are ready. Solve the price problem to buy your breakfast!

addition_class.title: Chapter 7: Ms. Addria and Addition up to 10

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: The next day the school starts. Matthew was excited and still felt overwhelmed. He went to his classroom and met his teacher, Ms. Addria. He introduced himself.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Good morning! My name is Matthew, and I am eager to learn how to add numbers!

dialogues.name: ms. addria
dialogues.log: Welcome, Matthew! Today we discuss basic counting up to 10 and adding numbers up to 10. Remember: you can repeat my discussion or tutorial anytime, and I can show you more samples whenever you need!

dialogues.name: ms. addria
dialogues.log: Now that we have discussed our lesson and explored visual examples, let us take the Addition Test! Show what you have learned!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: After completing the Addition Class, Matthew went to the principal and showed his papers as proof of mastery.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Principal Archimedes! Here are my test papers from Ms. Addria's Addition class with all the clue words!

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Outstanding work, Matthew! By the authority of AcadeMath, I award you this GOLD MEDAL and the Addition Clue Words Book! This unlocks your next subject: Subtraction!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew goes home and sleeps, his mind absorbing the addition formulas and clue words.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I really understood how addition joins things together today! Tomorrow is Subtraction class with Mr. Minus...

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Morning arrives! Matthew visits Baker Pip to buy food before heading to class.

dialogues.name: baker pip
dialogues.log: Welcome back! Today we have honey clover biscuits. Calculate your change to purchase!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: After passing the Addition class, Matthew needs to learn how to subtract, where his new teacher is Mr. Minus.

dialogues.name: mr. minus
dialogues.log: Greetings, Matthew! I am Mr. Minus. Subtraction is the art of taking away, finding differences, and counting what remains. Let us begin our tutorial!

dialogues.name: mr. minus
dialogues.log: Time for your Subtraction Test! Remember the clue words: difference, remaining, left, and how many more!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew completed the Subtraction class, talked to the principal, and presented his completed papers.

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Splendid achievement! For mastering subtraction, I bestow upon you the PLATINUM MEDAL and the Subtraction Clue Words Book! You may now enter Multiplication Class with Ms. Timi!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew goes home and sleeps peacefully, preparing for the magic of equal groups.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Subtraction makes so much sense now! Tomorrow I will meet Ms. Timi for Multiplication!

dialogues.name: baker pip
dialogues.log: Ready for another day of learning, Matthew? Here are berry cluster rolls!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: For Multiplication, Matthew's teacher was Ms. Timi.

dialogues.name: ms. timi
dialogues.log: Welcome, Matthew! Multiplication is repeated addition with equal groups! When you see rows, arrays, or the words "each" and "product", multiplication is your best friend!

dialogues.name: ms. timi
dialogues.log: Show your multiplication mastery on this examination to earn your third medal!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew showed his multiplication proof papers to Principal Archimedes.

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Remarkable! You have earned the EMERALD MEDAL and the Multiplication Clue Words Book! Now, you advance to your final subject: Division with Mr. David!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew goes home and sleeps, dreaming of arrays and number multiplications.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Multiplication was so fun! One more class left: Division with Mr. David!

dialogues.name: baker pip
dialogues.log: The final class day is here! Fuel up with our golden crystal waffles!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: For Division, Matthew's teacher was Mr. David.

dialogues.name: mr. david
dialogues.log: Greetings, Matthew! Division is the fair sharing of an entire total into equal portions. When you see clue words like "shared equally", "per person", and "quotient", think Division!

dialogues.name: mr. david
dialogues.log: Here is your Division and Multi-Step problem test. Solve each problem step by step!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew showed his division test papers to Principal Archimedes.

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Magnificent! You have conquered all four arithmetic classes! I award you the DIAMOND MEDAL! Now that you have completed all of your classes, I shall personally assist you to our Academy Library!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew sleeps peacefully. Tomorrow, he will visit the librarian Ms. Richie and face the Great Wizard's challenge.

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I have earned all four medals: Gold, Platinum, Emerald, and Diamond! I feel so much more confident about math now!

library_ms_richie.title: Chapter 15: Ms. Richie and the Reviewer Book

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: After he completed all of his classes, the principal assisted Matthew to the librarian named Ms. Richie.

dialogues.name: mr. archimedes
dialogues.log: Ms. Richie, meet Matthew! He has collected all four arithmetic medals and is preparing for the Wizard's ultimate challenge.

dialogues.name: ms. richie
dialogues.log: Welcome, young scholar Matthew! I have prepared this Grand Reviewer Book for you. It contains comprehensive notes, clue words, and practice questions covering all the possible challenges the Wizard might present!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Thank you, Ms. Richie! Let us review the clue words and practice multi-step problems before meeting the Wizard!

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: Let us solve these interactive reviewer problems together! Once we finish, we will proceed to the Wizard's Castle!

wizard_final_trial.title: Chapter 16: The Great Math Wizard's Final Trial

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew and Arith went to the Great Math Wizard to test his knowledge and learnings during his time at Magi-Mathica.

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: Welcome back, Matthew and Arith! I see the brilliance of the Gold, Platinum, Emerald, and Diamond medals on your chest. Are you ready for the ultimate test of Magi-Mathica?

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I am ready, Great Wizard! I understand the clue words, the operations, and how to solve multi-step real-life math problems!

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: Let the Final Trial begin!

dialogues.name: the great math wizard
dialogues.log: Sensational! You passed my Test with extraordinary skill, Matthew! As promised, here is the Magical Portal Key to open your pathway home!

dialogues.name: arith
dialogues.log: You did it, Matthew! You mastered all the curriculum concepts and collected all the Learning Experience!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: Thank you Arith, thank you Great Wizard, and thank you AcadeMath! I am ready to return home!

return_earth_exam.title: Chapter 18: Return to Earth & The Examination

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: Matthew stepped through the magical portal and arrived back home. He was now confident to take the examination that he needed to pass.

dialogues.name: ma'am cruz
dialogues.log: Welcome to your Math Examination, Matthew. Here is your test paper. Take a deep breath and do your best!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I can do this! I can identify the clue words and break down every problem step by step!

dialogues.name: ma'am cruz
dialogues.log: Matthew... this is extraordinary! You scored a PERFECT grade on the Math Examination! You have truly mastered elementary mathematics!

dialogues.name: matthew
dialogues.log: I did it! Math is no longer a scary mystery. It is a wonderful puzzle with clues in every sentence!

dialogues.name: narrator
dialogues.log: And so, Matthew was no longer struggling. He was confident and inspired, ready to conquer any math problem in life. The end.
